lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-density clusters of circular high-luminance pixels arranged in a semi-stochastic pattern posterior to the branchial region, transitioning from smaller, tightly grouped clusters anteriorly to larger, more distantly spaced nodes toward the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the lateral spots to form a discernible grid-like anchor system across the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift consisting of high-intensity upper boundaries and shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin exhibits a uniform distribution of small, high-luminance circular spots.
